messages.subject: Work Session / World Cup tomorrow
parts:
Hi all,

It's been pointed out to me that tomorrow's meeting is during the Netherlands-Argentina world cup semifinal, so our meeting may be more sparsely attended than usual.  If you ARE planning on coming, could you let me know?  We may cancel if there's no interest.

If we do meet, I point out that our room has an enormous screen.  We can put the game on and attempt to "work" simultaneously.

Viva [your team here]!

Noam
